sources.title: GitHub - johnpospisil/cart-pole-rl: A Cart Pole reinforcement learning ...
sources.snippet: This project implements and compares 5 reinforcement learning algorithms on the classic CartPole-v1 control problem from OpenAI Gymnasium. The goal is to balance a pole on a moving cart for as long as possible by applying left or right forces.
